title: cloneOrPull function is private and untestable
description: Verified: src/index.ts:85 — `const cloneOrPull = (repo, targetBase, existing): SyncResult` is declared as a module-level `const` (not exported). The function encapsulates the core git clone/pull logic but cannot be imported or unit-tested. The existing test file test/index.test.ts only tests the exported functions (parseArgs, resolveTargetPath, listFolders, stripQuotes). This is already noted in the starred-repo-sync feature.json notes: 'cloneOrPull is private (not exported) and cannot be unit-tested without refactoring.'
spec:
1. Export the cloneOrPull function from src/index.ts by changing `const cloneOrPull` to `export const cloneOrPull`.
2. Add unit tests in test/index.test.ts for cloneOrPull covering: successful clone, successful pull, clone failure (nonexistent URL), pull failure (merge conflict).
3. Mock `execFileSync` using `bun:test`'s mock mechanism to avoid needing real git operations in tests.

IMPORTANT: After resolving this finding, locate the feature.json file(s) in .aidd/features/ whose spec originally produced the code or pattern that caused this audit finding. Update those feature.json spec(s) to prevent this issue from being reintroduced during a feature-based rebuild.
